metadata.title: Bicalutamide Therapy
metadata.indication: Advanced prostate cancer with LHRH analogue therapy or surgical castration.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain explicitly unassessed and never block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source-reconciled draft; independent approval pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: Current NCCP and product information reconciled for this release; declared discrepancies and independent review remain outstanding.

source_discrepancies: NCCP does not specify hepatic dose reduction; SmPC additionally cautions about accumulation in moderate/severe impairment and requires discontinuation for severe hepatic changes.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by the appropriately qualified Consultant specified in the NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification or non-standard continuation should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Source-reconciled feasibility encoding for NCCP 00482 v3; current source and independent clinical/pharmacy review remain required.

severe_hepatic_changes.label: Severe hepatic changes require discontinuation. Investigate liver injury; no invented numeric bicalutamide threshold.

coumarin_anticoagulant.label: Bicalutamide can increase warfarin/coumarin effect. Closely monitor PT/INR and review anticoagulant dose.

other_significant_interaction.label: Review CYP3A4 substrates, ciclosporin, calcium-channel blockers and other interactions with pharmacy.

prior_permanent_stop.label: A previous permanent stop remains effective despite recovered tests.

medical_or_surgical_castration_confirmed.label: Concurrent LHRH analogue or surgical castration confirmed

action.message: The NCCP does not require a dose adjustment, but SmPC warns of accumulation in moderate/severe impairment. Monitor carefully; consider periodic liver testing, especially in the first six months.

action.message: NCCP 00482 is bicalutamide 50 mg with LHRH analogue or surgical castration; it is not a 150 mg monotherapy service.

rules.explanation: NCCP 00482 is bicalutamide 50 mg with LHRH analogue or surgical castration; it is not a 150 mg monotherapy service.

administration.instructions: Take at the same time daily with or without food; swallow whole. If missed or vomited, take only the next scheduled dose; do not replace or double.

treatment.additional_requirement: Use with LHRH analogue therapy or surgical castration.
treatment.schedule_summary: Bicalutamide 50 mg orally once daily continuously with LHRH analogue or surgical castration.
treatment.duration_text: Until progression or unacceptable toxicity; follow individual plan

regular: FBC, renal and liver profile and glucose as clinically indicated
Consider periodic liver testing, particularly during the first six months
Close PT/INR monitoring with coumarin anticoagulants

supportive_care.mapping_basis: The NCCP regimen classifies this oral SACT as minimal emetogenic risk; the linked oral minimal-to-low supportive-care guidance is used rather than a parenteral prescription sheet.
